description: This file defines the implementation of the ServerConfig class, which manages a list of STUN servers for WebRTC ICE configuration, including converting the server list to a JSON format.

classes.name: ServerConfig
classes.description: A class that holds a list of STUN server URLs and provides a method to serialize this list into JSON format.

methods.name: ServerConfig
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server list with provided STUN server URLs.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Converts the list of STUN servers into a JSON object suitable for WebRTC ICE configuration.
